variants.text: The tube breathes past you on its own schedule and the schedule is the thing. Somebody has forty years of it written down in soot, and going up there without knowing when it breathes in is going up there once.
Dressed stone, and the lava went around it rather than over. You would want to be very sure of the rhythm.
Warm air, in, then out, then in. It has been doing that since before the village and it is not the mountain.
